description: This file defines the 'Auditable' interface with methods for accessing and setting an 'AuditSection' object, used for auditing purposes within the package.

classes.name: Auditable
classes.description: An interface for objects that can provide auditing information through an AuditSection.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the AuditSection associated with the object.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the AuditSection for the object.
